column1: # Quota readings, recorded on the operator's instruction (Telegram 2367, 2026-08-04).
# Purpose: make consumption measurable instead of impressional -- he wants to see what a
# lane-hour actually costs in percent of quota. This file is the manual seed of workboard
# row V3-3.10 (per-provider consumption persisted across restarts); it is a hand-kept
# ledger until that lands, and it is deliberately tracked so a rebuild keeps the history.
# Readings are OPERATOR-SUPPLIED, and that is a constraint rather than a preference:
# daemon/vendor-quota.ts can read Codex quota from its JSONL, but returns Claude as
# `{ state: 'unknown' }` -- there is no machine-readable Claude signal on this host. So the
# orchestrator cannot take a reading by itself, and a delta between two rows only exists if
# he sent a screenshot at both ends. A missing morning row means "not measured", not "no
# consumption". This is the exact asymmetry V3-3.10 has to solve.
# Readings come from the Claude usage panel screenshot the operator sends. Percentages are
# "used", not remaining. A field that was not visible in the source is recorded as
# "unmeasured" and NEVER as 0 -- Hard Floor 7: absence of a reading is not a reading of
# zero, and this file will be graphed.
